trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Valid index range determined by num_embeddings or selected dimension size.
trigger_condition.value_trigger: Index tensor contains at least one value outside the valid range for the selected dimension, such as index >= num_embeddings or index outside [-dim_size, dim_size - 1].
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Run torch.index_select or nn.Embedding on MPS with index tensors containing out-of-bound values; compare against CPU reference behavior.

root_cause.backend_layer: MPS backend missing index bounds validation in index_select and embedding lookup.

bug_oracle.description: MPS operation succeeds and may return invalid results for out-of-range indices, while CPU/reference raises IndexError.
bug_oracle.signal: CPU reference raises IndexError but MPS returns a tensor without exception.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate index tensors to include boundary values: maximum valid index, maximum valid index plus one, large positive invalid index, and negative out-of-range index.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct embedding tables or input tensors on MPS with varying num_embeddings, selected dimension sizes, and index lengths.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force execution on MPS backend and run equivalent operation on CPU as a reference backend.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Execute torch.index_select or nn.Embedding.forward with mutated index tensors and record return values or exceptions.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Flag cases where the CPU reference raises IndexError but MPS succeeds or returns incorrect results, indicating missing index validation.
